newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures end with strong gains.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures end with strong gains.

text.p: Feb 4 - U.S. stock index futures closed with strong gains and near the highs of the session set late. A sharp recovery in NASDAQ stocks in late afternoon activity prompted buying in S&P 500s, triggering buy stops above 791.00 in the March contract. Traders said the rise was orderly and arbitragers stayed on the sidelines. Firmness in bonds limited pressure on stock earlier.
